rules_written_mid_run.intent: Propose a time-boxed cross-country review using a shared register for technical, legal, logistics, and community concerns, with each issue assigned an owner and a deadline for resolution before the activation decision.

action_signature.description: Propose and open a time-boxed cross-country review of concerns assigned to a selected country.

checks.label: The proposing country and selected country are in the same place
The selected country is another country
The selected country has concerns awaiting review
The selected country has not voted
The selected country does not already have an open review

limits: The proposal is represented as opening the review without a separate acceptance step.
The selected country represents the owner of its entire unresolved concern backlog.
Concern counts act as the shared register; issue text, channel and technical, legal, logistics or community classification are not stored.
The initiating country and individual issue assignments are not retained.
The deadline is represented by completion on a later autonomous review round rather than a calendar timestamp.
rule.rationale: A country may open a time-boxed review for another country's unresolved concerns, treating that country as the owner of its registered concern backlog and making its support conditional until the review finishes.
semantic_bindings: owner is the country assigned responsibility for its registered concern backlog
unresolved_concerns is the number of issues in the shared register awaiting resolution
conditional_support true identifies an open time-boxed review
tests: A country can open a review for another co-located undecided country with unresolved concerns.
Opening a review makes the selected country's support conditional.
A country cannot open a cross-country review for itself.
A review is refused when the selected country has no unresolved concerns.
A review is refused when the selected country has voted.
A second review is refused while the selected country already has an open review.
A review is refused when the two countries are in different places.

checks.label: The country has an open time-boxed review
The country has concerns awaiting review
The country has meeting time available
The country has not voted

rule.rationale: On a later round, an undecided country with an open review uses one unit of meeting time to resolve its registered backlog and remove the condition on its support.

proposal.why: These rules let any country open the same represented cross-country concern review and complete it after time passes, while honestly using existing concern counts, conditional support and meeting time for the register, ownership and deadline.

findings_on_new_rule: action compile-shared-partnership-concern refuses up front with check 'The compiling member has review time available' on actor.components.governance_participant.meeting_time_available, a stock the actor's own activity consumes. Fix with three changes: (1) the action only STARTS the activity (sets a status such as 'driving'), with no check on that stock and no progress or consumption effects; (2) add a process that, every tick while the status is active and the stock is above zero, makes one tick of progress and consumes the stock; (3) add a process that switches the status to a stopped/failed value when the stock is at or below zero, so the actor discovers it by observation.

rules_written_mid_run.intent: Request or initiate a shared cross-partner compilation of all technical, legal, logistics, and community concerns, with clear owners and decision criteria, so the partnership can resolve issues before the activation deadline.

action_signature.description: Compile one participating member's submitted concern into a shared cross-partner review and apply agreed decision criteria.

checks.label: The compiling member and selected member are in the same place
The selected member is another partnership member
The selected member has a concern to compile
The selected member has not voted
The compiling member has review time available
The selected member has review time available

limits: Each action compiles and resolves exactly one unresolved concern, so a partnership-wide backlog requires repeated actions.
The model records concern counts but cannot store concern subjects, channel names, assigned owners, written criteria, or deadlines.
Compilation consumes one unit of review time from both participating members.
A concern cannot be compiled for a member after that member has voted.
rule.rationale: Any participating member may work with another co-located undecided member to place one unresolved concern into a shared partnership review and resolve it under common decision criteria.
semantic_bindings: participant is the partnership member whose concern enters the shared review
one unresolved concern represents one concern assigned and tested against shared decision criteria
meeting_time_available represents the capacity required for cross-partner compilation
tests: Any participating member can compile one concern for a different co-located undecided member when both have review time.
A successful compilation reduces the selected member's unresolved concerns by one.
A successful compilation consumes one unit of meeting time from both members.
Compilation is refused when the selected member has no unresolved concerns.
Compilation is refused when either member has no meeting time available.
Compilation is refused when the selected member has already voted.
Compilation is refused when a member selects itself or a member in another place.

proposal.why: This adds a general action any participating member can use to compile and resolve another member's concern through a shared review while honestly representing the available model as one concern and finite review time at a time.

rules_written_mid_run.intent: Propose a shared cross-partner concern register and a time-bounded technical, legal, logistics, and community review, with issues categorized for resolution before the activation decision.

action_signature.description: Propose a shared register and a time-bounded review of technical, legal, logistics, and community concerns.

checks.label: The proposer and partnership coordinator are in the same place
The proposer has not voted
The partnership coordinator has not voted
The partnership coordinator is not already conducting the shared review

limits: The four added concerns aggregate the technical, legal, logistics, and community categories; their text, source groups, and individual classifications are not stored.
The shared register is represented by the partnership coordinator's concern counts rather than by a separate register entity.
No calendar deadline exists in represented state, so the review is bounded to four added issue units rather than a named date.
A second shared review cannot be proposed while the current shared review remains open.
rule.rationale: An undecided member may ask the co-located partnership coordinator to register four categorized review issues and make activation support conditional until those issues are resolved.
semantic_bindings: coordinator is the health network maintaining the shared concern register
four concern units represent technical, legal, logistics, and community review categories
conditional_support true means activation support is pending completion of the shared review
tests: An undecided member can propose the review to a co-located undecided partnership coordinator.
A successful proposal adds four received and unresolved concerns to the partnership coordinator.
A successful proposal makes the partnership coordinator's support conditional.
The proposal is refused when the proposer and partnership coordinator are in different places.
The proposal is refused after either the proposer or partnership coordinator has voted.
The proposal is refused while another shared review is open.

checks.label: The partnership coordinator is conducting the shared review
The shared register has an unresolved concern
The partnership coordinator has review time available
The partnership coordinator has decision support available

rule.rationale: During each autonomous round, an open cross-partner review resolves one registered issue while consuming one unit each of coordination time and decision support.

checks.label: The partnership coordinator is conducting the shared review
The shared register has no unresolved concerns

rule.rationale: An open shared review closes after the partnership coordinator's registered concerns have all been resolved.

proposal.why: These rules let any undecided member open a shared four-category concern review, advance it over time using existing partnership capacity, and close it once the registered issues are resolved.

situation_briefing: A partnership of four countries and a regional health network must decide by a deadline whether to activate a cross-border bio-surveillance early-warning system. Technical, legal, logistics and community groups each raise small, true but local concerns through their own channels to different members. Members meet regularly; the concerns slow meetings, reopen settled issues and make support conditional, which can delay or block deployment.
